narrative_prose: The dense warmth of the hearth presses outward against the chilling draft of the valley floor, the copper kettles glowing a deep umber in the low light. Plumes of spiced steam catch the erratic flickers of the ferrofluid manifold's ambient glow. It is a tight, secure sanctuary of boiling stock and scrubbed metal, anchoring the chaotic sprawl of the settlement. Ryn braces herself, working to DEFEND the delicate broth from the unpredictable Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea outside, letting the deep roasted aromas CONCEAL the faint tang of ozone leaking through the seals. She ensures everyone gets a bowl to CONSUME before the biting cold returns. With the last portion ready, she explicitly hands the heavy, steaming ceramic bowl—an actual physical object—to Silas to complete the baton transfer for the evening.
